Package org.webharvest.events

Class HarvesterEventSink

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.webharvest.events.HarvesterEventSink
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    EventSink
    public final class HarvesterEventSink
extends Object
implements EventSink
    Implementation of EventSink intended to guarantee scraping scope's events delivery. Published HarvesterEvent is routed to appropriate scope's EventBus that is associated with it. The scope resolution takes place on Registry that binds Harvester scope's with instance of EventBus which lives in this scope. In case it is not possible to particular EventBus (it has not been registered yet or for whatever reason) then the IllegalStateException is thrown. For multi-threded environment the appropriate type of Registry needs to be injected.
